notes: Document is a DOE grant Final Report (award DE-FC36-05GO15103, Duke University), not a review, perspective, thesis, patent or abstract without data, so not_primary was not applied; it reports original data. H2 uptake on Duke-made carbons was measured by project working partners (NREL Sieverts/PCTPro-2000 at 77 K and 2 bar, Table 2 p. 13 and Table 3 p. 22; CalTech custom Sieverts and SwRI isotherms, Figures 19-20, pp. 23-24). Table 3 also lists comparison materials quoted from other work (B/C, CMK-1, AX-21, Corncob), which are not the paper's own values. The report lists a related publication (McNicholas et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 2010, PEEK carbons) and cites it, but nowhere states that every H2 uptake value it reports was published before, so duplicate_data was not applied. record.json is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the PDF.
